revision_summary: One quote has a timestamp mismatch: the grounded_examples[1] quote 'everything looks good on my end...kilowatt usage on your Pepco bill' is correctly transcribed but occurs at 03:03, not 02:56 as claimed — fix the timestamp. Additionally, reconsider the schema classification of the 02:51 'did your neighbors get solar with Ion Solar?' moment — this is a legitimacy/referral question, not a cross_sell_signals miss per schema section 12 (which covers roofing/battery/secondary-structure signals); reclassify or relabel under a trust-building/legitimacy category. Similarly, the invocation of bill_collection.alternative_paths (elderly_low_tech/shopping_customer protocols) in rep_intent.evidence[2] and multi_touch_patterns[0].stewart_read is a stretch — those paths trigger on tech/navigation friction or being away from home, neither of which is shown here; either drop the schema citation or replace with a more accurate framing (e.g., simple deferral without escalation to a locked callback time). Finally, add a note on script_coverage for the 'prior_design' item (02:44) flagging the ambiguous/garbled 'not really' response, for consistency with how the 02:51 garbled segment was already flagged as a possible transcription artifact. The outcome dispute (reclassifying to no_appointment) is well-supported and should stand.
